_comment: Native code compiled or linked into the app that is not a Rust crate or an npm package. whisper.cpp's licence text is read from the whisper-rs-sys crate it is built from; the libraries of the pinned sherpa-onnx static archive ship no licence files, so their licence and copyright line are recorded here (versions read from the libraries where they carry one) and filled into the standard texts in scripts/licence-texts/. Check these against the upstream projects when the archive changes.
